# `chat` — `/api/chat`

<a id="ws-api-chat-ws"></a>
### `WS /api/chat/ws`

Public chat. The first message names the nickname; then messages go both ways. Off unless the Grove has a room; at most two windows per member.

- Handler: [`chat_ws`](../../../backend/routers/chat.py)
- Who may call: Any signed-in member

**Response**

- WebSocket. Protocol: [Public chat](../../API.md#public-chat-apichatws).

| Status | Detail | Raised in |

| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
